caption: The drawing features a single dark-colored teapot placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The teapot has an oval-shaped body with a textured, hammered surface. Its lower half is decorated with a pattern of vertical and horizontal lines resembling a basket weave. The teapot has a curved handle on the left that is ornate and a long, slightly upturned spout on the right. The lid is domed with a small knob at the top and fits snugly into the teapot's opening. The overall color of the teapot is a mix of dark gray and black shades, with some lighter highlights indicating reflections and contours. The drawing is signed “H.A. Marsh” in small, purple letters to the right of the teapot's base.
title: Wedgewood Teapot
